zh.title: 國籍航空國際線燃油附加費10月7日起調漲
zh.summary: 民航局：短程調漲至37.5美元；長程97.5美元
body: 交通部民用航空局10月1日發布新聞稿表示，由於航空燃油價格近期上漲，國籍航空公司國際航線客運燃油附加費將自本月7日起調漲。
民航局指出，調整後短程航線燃油附加費由32.5美元調漲為37.5美元，長程航線由84.5美元調漲為97.5美元。
民航局說明，依據中油今日公告之國際航線航空燃油價格，由每桶156.79元調漲為177.89美元。
民航局表示，該調整機制係於2005年與國籍航空公司協調，以中油公司公告之國際航空燃油每桶牌價為收取基準。

en.title: Taiwan CAA: International fuel surcharges to rise from Oct 7
en.summary: CAA: Short-haul surcharge to US$37.5; long-haul US$97.5
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) said in an Oct. 1 press release that international passenger fuel surcharges for Taiwanese carriers will increase starting Oct 7, citing a recent rise in jet fuel prices.
The CAA said short-haul surcharges will rise from US$32.50 to US$37.50, while long-haul surcharges will increase from US$84.50 to US$97.50.
According to CPC Corporation's latest listed international jet fuel price, which rose from US$156.79 to US$177.89 per barrel, the surcharge tier moves from the 13th to the 15th level, the CAA said.
The adjustment mechanism was coordinated between the CAA and domestic carriers in 2005 based on CPC Corporation's listed international aviation fuel price per barrel.

zh.title: 華航招募逾百名客艙組員及貨運人才
zh.summary: 華航宣佈啟動2026下半年徵才；客艙組員報名10月5日至12日；貨運營運人員10月1日至14日報名
body: 中華航空今天宣佈，因應新世代機隊引進與全球航網拓展，預計招募合計逾百名客艙組員及貨運營運人員。客艙組員招募於10月5日至12日開放報名，初試與複試分別於11月7日及11月14日舉行，錄取者最快明年1月中旬報到。
華航同步招募貨運營運人員，報名期間為10月1日至10月14日，職務內容包含管理全球客貨機航班貨運作業、平衡表製作和盤櫃規劃等。華航指出，今年率先推出生成式AI貨運客服，並擴充智慧訂位功能。
華航表示，提供完善教育訓練制度和職涯發展環境，包含員工及眷屬優待機票、社團活動、心理諮商、運動活動等。

en.title: China Airlines launches recruitment for over 100 cabin crew and cargo staff
en.summary: China Airlines to hire over 100 cabin crew and cargo staff; cabin crew applications Oct 5-12, cargo Oct 1-14; reporting from January
body: China Airlines announced on Tuesday that it plans to recruit more than 100 cabin crew members and cargo operation personnel as it introduces new-generation aircraft and expands its global network.

Applications for cabin crew open from October 5 to 12, with initial and final interviews scheduled for November 7 and November 14, respectively. Successful candidates may start reporting as early as mid-January next year.

The cargo operations positions open from October 1 to 14, with duties including managing global cargo operations for passenger and cargo flights, load sheet production, and pallet planning. The airline also highlighted its launch of a generative AI cargo customer service and enhanced smart booking functions.
